projects.title: Network Security Scanner
projects.description: Python-based tool that scans local networks for open ports, identifies running services, and flags potential vulnerabilities. Built with socket programming and multithreading for speed.

projects.title: Password Strength Auditor
projects.description: Analyzes password policies and tests password strength against common attack vectors including dictionary attacks, brute force patterns, and known breached passwords.

projects.title: Log Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive dashboard for parsing and visualizing security logs. Identifies patterns, anomalies, and potential security incidents from system and application logs.
